definition: to stay somewhere briefly on a long trip
description: Seen through the eyes of a person standing on gravel, both hands raised, a navy duffel bag flies through the air and is caught. A laughing young man with curly hair and an open white shirt kneels on the roof of a white camper van and has just tossed it down. On the left a young woman carries a rolled sleeping bag into a pale green roadside motel room, and another young woman crouches by a cool box at the van. A pink neon star glows on a pole against an orange desert sunset.

taps.phrase: to toss down a duffel bag

taps.target: the woman at the motel door
the woman in the grey T-shirt
